newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Implats says NUM to strike at refineries.
newsitem.headline: Implats says NUM to strike at refineries.

text.p: Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that the National Union of Mineworkers had issued formal notification of a strike at Implats platinum refineries which will start on Friday, August 1.

"Following annual wage negotiations between the (NUM) and Impala Platinum Ltd-Refineries which resulted in deadlock, the NUM has issued a formal notification of a protected strike... This strike is scheduled to commence on 1 August and only effects Refineries," Implats said in a statement.
Implats said the NUM membership within the affected bargaining unit at Refineries totals 415 members.

Implats Refineries management and the NUM met on four occasions but settlement on annual wage increases could not be reached and the NUM declared a dispute which was referred to the Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration.
Two further conciliation meetings were held after that but no settlemnt was achieved, Implats said.
Management's last wage offer was a 10.7 percent increase, the NUM's last offer was 19.2 percent.

"The management at Refineries remains committed to a negotiated settlement. All efforts will be made by management to minimise the impact of the strike on the production of metals for Impala Platinum's customers," Implats said.
Implats produced 499,000 ounces of refined platinum in the six months to end-December 1996.
